'''IG-88C''' was an IG-88 series [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]]. He was third to be activated by [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88A]] and thus was given the designation "C". He and [[IG-88D/Legends|IG-88D]] acted as sentries for [[Mechis III/Legends|Mechis III]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
[[File:IG-88C_Aggressor_XWM.png|thumb|left|250px|IG-88C piloting his personal [[IG-2000/Legends|''IG-2000'']]]]
IG-88C was created on [[Halowan]] by the [[Holowan Mechanicals/Legends|Holowan Mechanicals]] Company in the [[Project Phlutdroid/Legends|Project Phlutdroid]]. After a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] of identical model called [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88A]] turned against his biological creators, he then proceeded to activate and copy his programming into the other inactive droid's empty computer cores. A named the other droids by letter in order of activation. IG-88A designated him IG-88C. All the assassin droids then continued to escape the laboratory, with the help of an assassin droid of similar model, called [[IG-72/Legends|IG-72]], who denied the option of joining them on their mission but would help them escape. They then took a courier, escaped the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], and set their sights on the foundry world of [[Mechis III/Legends|Mechis III]].<ref name="TIA" />

===Droid revolution===
[[File:Chihdo_in_carbonite.jpg|thumb|left|160px|IG-88C with Chihdo frozen in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]].]]
The IG-88s managed to get all of the droids to kill the 73 organic [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] on the planet by slicing into the planet-wide defense grid. They then began reprogramming all the droids on Mechis III, so that they would have sentience programming, and obey their orders. Then they began to manufacture droids with embedded sentience programming so that when [[IG-88A/Legends|IG-88]] transmitted the signal, all the droids they manufactured would turn against their biological masters, thus taking over [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Thus was the beginning of the IG-88s' [[Droid Revolution]].<ref name="TIA" />

With IG-88A impersonating the now-deceased administrator of Mechis III and [[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88B]] acting as the bounty hunter "face" of the group, IG-88C and [[IG-88D/Legends|D]] were left to personally oversee the manufacturing of their plan and act as sentries for Mechis III. Soon after IG-88B was destroyed, C and D attacked [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] en route to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] above [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to steal [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] block in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] and avenge their lost "brother". Boba Fett turned against C in [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] and fired every weapon in his ship's arsenal. Seeing as how IG-88C thought that Fett's moves were "highly illogical", he could not&mdash;and did not&mdash;predict it and was destroyed.<ref name="SHE1" />
